name: Gojira Mod
description: June and Leon's kaiju: Gojira, a giant (54.67 = 164/3 blocks tall) dark grey dinosaur-like ocean monster with a long tail and pale spikes down its back. It swims in the ocean and wades onto land, is always angry, stomps the ground, roars "SKREEONK!" and breathes a glowing white beam. It can't be beaten: it heals faster than you can hurt it. Spawn it with the Gojira Spawn Egg.
